history.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-quality feature icon for Lineup, a native macOS settings suite, displayed at 20pt in a sidebar and 72pt in a pane header. Create ONE square 1024x1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha outside the icon. Straight-on orthographic view. A precisely centered rounded-square tile occupying 82% of the canvas, equal 9% transparent margins, corner radius about 22% of the tile side. Central motif occupies 58% of the tile width and must read at 20 pixels. Soft upper-left lighting. Inspiration: the craft and legibility of high-quality Apple-platform icons curated by Icon Museum, with one bold central concept, controlled depth and careful edge highlights. Original design, not a copy. No letters, numbers, labels, screenshots, device frames, perspective rotation, floor, cast shadow outside the tile, scenery, watermark, checkerboard pattern or opaque background. Keep silhouette simple and image genuinely transparent. Style/medium: quiet modern enamel. Nearly flat glossy colored enamel tile, one broad soft highlight, white symbol with very shallow raised bevel and a crisp small inner shadow. Restrained polish. Thin edge highlight only, no metallic frame, no thick extruded sides. Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its precise tile silhouette, front-on framing, ivory enamel relief, soft edge bevel, padding, lighting direction, and quiet premium finish. Replace the blue hue and the three-pane motif completely. Tile color: #C17F08, slightly lighter at the top and deeper at the bottom, remaining in this hue family. Subject: One large ivory white sun with a solid gently domed circular center and exactly eight short thick rounded rays, evenly spaced, generous clear gaps. A warm awake daytime metaphor. No facial features, switches, clocks or letters. Keep the motif ivory white with the shallow sculpted enamel depth of the reference. Do not retain the Zones window motif. Genuinely transparent background, no shadow or stray pixels outside the tile.
history.status: Previous approved artwork, retained unchanged.
